verses.text: Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Command di pikin dem of Israel, and tell dem, ‘When una come into di land of Canaan, dis na di land wey go fall to una for inheritance, even di land of Canaan, according to im borders,
una south side go be from di wilderness of Zin along by di side of Edom, and una south border go be from di end of di Salt Sea eastward.
Una border go turn about south of di ascent of Akrabbim, and go pass along to Zin, and di goings out of am go be south of Kadesh Barnea. E go go on to Hazar Addar, and pass along to Azmon.
Di border go turn about from Azmon to di brook of Egypt, and di goings out of am go be at di sea.
For di western border, una go get di Great Sea and im coast. Dis go be una west border.
Dis go be una north border: from di Great Sea una go mark out for yourselves Mount Hor.
From Mount Hor una go mark out to di entrance of Hamath, and di goings out of di border go be at Zedad.
Di border go go on to Ziphron, and di goings out of am go be at Hazar Enan. Dis go be una north border.
Una go mark out una east border from Hazar Enan to Shepham.
Di border go go down from Shepham to Riblah, on di east side of Ain. Di border go go down, and go reach to di side of di sea of Chinnereth eastward.
Di border go go down to di Jordan, and di goings out of am go be at di Salt Sea. Dis go be una land according to im borders round about.’”
Moses command di pikin dem of Israel, talk, “Dis na di land wey una go inherit by lot, wey di Lord command to give to di nine tribes, and to di half tribe,

because di tribe of di pikin dem of Reuben according to di house of dem papa dem, and di tribe of di pikin dem of Gad according to di house of dem papa dem, don receive dem inheritance. Di half tribe of Manasseh don receive dem inheritance.
Di two tribes and di half tribe don receive dem inheritance beyond di Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward di sunrise.”
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Dem na di names of di men wey go divide di land to una for inheritance: Eleazar di priest, and Joshua di pikin of Nun.
Una go take one prince of every tribe, to divide di land for inheritance.
Dem na di names of di men: Of di tribe of Judah, Caleb di pikin of Jephunneh.
Of di tribe of di pikin dem of Simeon, Shemuel di pikin of Ammihud.
Of di tribe of Benjamin, Elidad di pikin of Chislon.
Of di tribe of di pikin dem of Dan one prince, Bukki di pikin of Jogli.
Of di pikin dem of Joseph: of di tribe of di pikin dem of Manasseh one prince, Hanniel di pikin of Ephod.
Of di tribe of di pikin dem of Ephraim one prince, Kemuel di pikin of Shiphtan.
Of di tribe of di pikin dem of Zebulun one prince, Elizaphan di pikin of Parnach.
Of di tribe of di pikin dem of Issachar one prince, Paltiel di pikin of Azzan.
Of di tribe of di pikin dem of Asher one prince, Ahihud di pikin of Shelomi.
Of di tribe of di pikin dem of Naphtali one prince, Pedahel di pikin of Ammihud.”
Dem na di ones wey di Lord command to divide di inheritance to di pikin dem of Israel for di land of Canaan.
Di Lord speak to Moses for di plains of Moab by di Jordan at Jericho, talk,
“Command di pikin dem of Israel say make dem give to di Levites cities to dwell inside, from di inheritance of dem possession. Una go give pasture lands round about di cities to di Levites.
Di cities go be dem own to dwell inside, and dem pasture lands go be for dem cattle, and for dem possessions, and for all dem animals.
Di pasture lands of di cities, wey una go give to di Levites, go reach from di wall of di city and outward 1,000 cubits round about.

Una go measure outside di city for di east side 2,000 cubits, and for di south side 2,000 cubits, and for di west side 2,000 cubits, and for di north side 2,000 cubits, with di city for di middle. Dis go be to dem di pasture lands of di cities.
Di cities wey una go give to di Levites go be six cities of refuge, wey una go give for di manslayer to flee to. Besides dem una go give 42 cities.
All di cities wey una go give to di Levites go be 48 cities, dem with dem pasture lands.

Di cities wey una go give go be from di possession of di pikin dem of Israel. From di many una go take more, and from di few una go take less. Everyone according to im inheritance wey e inherit go give some of im cities to di Levites.”
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Speak to di pikin dem of Israel, and tell dem, ‘When una pass over di Jordan into di land of Canaan,
una go appoint cities to be cities of refuge for una, so that di manslayer wey kill any person unintentionally go flee dere.
Di cities go be to una for refuge from di avenger, so that di manslayer no go die until e stand before di congregation for judgment.
Di cities wey una go give go be six cities of refuge for una.
Una go give three cities beyond di Jordan, and una go give three cities for di land of Canaan. Dem go be cities of refuge.
Dem six cities go be refuge for di pikin dem of Israel, and for di stranger and for di sojourner among dem, so that anyone wey kill any person unintentionally fit flee dere.
But if e strike am with one instrument of iron, so that e die, e na murderer. Di murderer go surely dey put to death.
If e strike am with one stone for hand, by wey one fit die, and e die, e na murderer. Di murderer go surely dey put to death.
Or if e strike am with one weapon of wood for hand, by wey one fit die, and e die, e na murderer. Di murderer go surely dey put to death.
Di avenger of blood go put di murderer to death. When e meet am, e go put am to death.
If e thrust am of hatred, or throw something at am, lying in wait, so that e die,
or in enmity strike am with im hand, so that e die, di one wey strike am go surely dey put to death. E na murderer. Di avenger of blood go put di murderer to death, when e meet am.
But if e thrust am suddenly without enmity, or throw upon am anything without lying in wait,
or with any stone, by wey one fit die, without seeing am, and cast am on am, so that e die, and e no be im enemy, neither e seek im harm,
di congregation go judge between di striker and di avenger of blood according to dem ordinances.

Di congregation go deliver di manslayer out of di hand of di avenger of blood, and di congregation go restore am to im city of refuge, wia e flee. E go dwell inside am until di death of di high priest, wey dem anoint with di holy oil.
But if di manslayer go at any time beyond di border of im city of refuge, wia e flee,
and di avenger of blood find am outside di border of im city of refuge, and di avenger of blood kill di manslayer, e no go be guilty of blood,
because di manslayer must stay in im city of refuge until di death of di high priest. But after di death of di high priest di manslayer go return into di land of im possession.
Dem things go be for una for one statute of judgment throughout una generations for all una dwellings.
Whoever kill any person, di murderer go dey put to death at di mouth of witnesses, but one witness no go testify against any person to cause am to die.
Moreover una go take no ransom for di life of one murderer, wey dey guilty of death, but e go surely dey put to death.
Una go take no ransom for am wey don flee to im city of refuge, so that e go come again to dwell for di land, until di death of di priest.
So una no go pollute di land wia una dey, because blood pollute di land. No atonement fit dey made for di land for di blood wey dem shed inside am, except by di blood of am wey shed am.
Una no go defile di land wey una go inhabit, wia I dey dwell, because I, di Lord, dey dwell among di pikin dem of Israel.’”

Di heads of di papa houses of di family of di pikin dem of Gilead, di pikin of Machir, di pikin of Manasseh, of di families of di pikin dem of Joseph, come near, and speak before Moses, and before di princes, di heads of di papa houses of di pikin dem of Israel.

Dem talk, “Di Lord command my oga to give di land for inheritance by lot to di pikin dem of Israel. My oga dey commanded by di Lord to give di inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to im pikin woman dem.

If dem marry any of di pikin man dem of di other tribes of di pikin dem of Israel, dem inheritance go dey taken from di inheritance of our papa dem, and go dey added to di inheritance of di tribe wey dem go belong to. Na so e go dey taken from di lot of our inheritance.

When di jubilee of di pikin dem of Israel go be, dem inheritance go dey added to di inheritance of di tribe wey dem go belong to. So dem inheritance go dey taken away from di inheritance of di tribe of our papa dem.”
Moses command di pikin dem of Israel according to di word of di Lord, talk, “Di tribe of di pikin dem of Joseph speak well.
Dis na di thing wey di Lord command concerning di pikin woman dem of Zelophehad, talk, ‘Make dem marry to whom dem think best. Only dem must marry into di family of di tribe of dem papa dem.
So no inheritance of di pikin dem of Israel go pass from tribe to tribe, because every one of di pikin dem of Israel go hold to di inheritance of di tribe of im papa dem.

Every pikin woman wey possess one inheritance in any tribe of di pikin dem of Israel go be wife to one of di family of di tribe of im papa, so that di pikin dem of Israel go possess every man di inheritance of im papa dem.
No inheritance go pass from one tribe to another tribe, because di tribes of di pikin dem of Israel go hold each to im own inheritance.’”
Even as di Lord command Moses, so di pikin woman dem of Zelophehad do.
Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, di pikin woman dem of Zelophehad, marry dem papa brothers pikin man dem.
Dem marry into di families of di pikin dem of Manasseh di pikin of Joseph, and dem inheritance remain for di tribe of di family of dem papa.
Dem na di commandments and di ordinances wey di Lord command by di hand of Moses to di pikin dem of Israel for di plains of Moab by di Jordan at Jericho.
